How to use Ndamba

For coaches, analysts and clubs who want one game model from U8 to the first team, and for young players who want to understand the game and follow their progress.

Open Ndamba ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to ndamba-two.vercel.app.

2

FR and EN at the top right switch the whole site and app.

3

To look around first, click Pro club demo or U13 academy demo: the app opens with a sample team, no account needed.

4

To set up your own team, click Get started with Mola and answer its questions.

5

The menu on the left, or the bar at the bottom on a phone, opens Drills, Sessions, Week, Team, Matches, Analysis, Video, Player space and Books.

6

Your data stays in the browser on the device you use.

02

Features

01

Mola, the agent

Mola, camfranglais for mate, sets up your profile while you chat, then works in the app with the same tools you use: it plans a week, builds a session, sets up a match and drafts a call-up. Nothing leaves the app without your approval.

STEPS

  1. Type a request or tap a suggestion
  2. Follow the work in Tasks
  3. Approve what goes out in To approve
02

The 64 drills

The drills of the Njangi Code in 8 families: technique and patterns, rondos, positional games, small and large-sided games, phases of play, transitions and finishing. Each card shows its diagram, what it trains, the age from which it works, its length and the number of players.

STEPS

  1. Search by name or code, such as R02
  2. Filter by family
  3. Open a card to see its diagram and steps
03

The training week

Each day is named against the next match: MD-4 for tension, MD-3 for duration, MD-2 for speed, MD-1 for activation, MD+1 for recovery. Sessions are built from the drills, and the week's load, minutes times intensity, is drawn on a chart.

STEPS

  1. Open Week
  2. Add a session on a day
  3. Check the load chart
04

Live tagging

From the touchline, one tap per action: pass, pass lost, progressive pass, line broken, final third, box, shot, goal, pins two, switch, loss, won back within 5 seconds and the opponent's shots. The Njangi Index moves with every tap. Everything is saved on the device, even with no network.

STEPS

  1. Open Analysis, then Go live
  2. Start the clock
  3. Tap each action, Undo if needed
05

The match report

After the match, the Njangi Index out of 100 with five sub-indices out of 20: progression, penetration, fixation, regain and control. A summary says how the team played, and objectives for the coming week come from the numbers.

STEPS

  1. Open an analysed match
  2. Read the sub-indices
  3. Copy as text or Print
06

Player space

Each player sees the week, form and load, the last match, objectives, a self-assessment and the whole journey, season after season. Young players also get the 40 Ball Lessons from the novel and a notebook.

STEPS

  1. Open Player space
  2. Pick a player
  3. Switch tabs: week, load, match, journey
07

Lionceaux Football

An eleven-a-side match game on a red-earth neighbourhood pitch, with the crowd all around: sixteen sides from Douala and Yaoundé, a friendly match or the holiday tournament from the round of 16 to the final. It plays in the browser with fingers on a phone, a PS5 controller or the keyboard, and the page explains every control.

STEPS

  1. Open Football game in the menu
  2. Read How to play
  3. Press Play, phone sideways
03Tips
  • Start with a demo: the pro club and the U13 academy each come with a squad, sessions and matches to explore.
  • For live tagging, count the five seconds after a loss under your breath, and tap a shirt number to credit the player.
  • Data stays on the device: use the same phone or computer for a team.
04FAQ
Is it free?

The two books, the 64 drills, one team and one match analysed live are free. Premium plans start at 4.99 dollars a month; while Mobile Money and card payments are coming, any plan can be activated in demo mode.

Do I need a network at the pitch?

No. Tags, clock and score are saved on the device with every tap.

Does Mola send messages for me?

No. Mola prepares inside the app; a WhatsApp message, a text, an e-mail or a calendar file waits for your approval, and you send it.

What is the Njangi Index?

A score from 0 to 100 that says whether the team kept the ball with purpose, built from five sub-indices: progression, penetration, fixation, regain and control.

Which languages?

French and English.
